name: The Cut
text: Long ago two serpent-gods tore the Mother Below in half. One half became the sky and the other became the earth.
unlockText: Any of S15, S16, S20, S21

name: The Mother Below
text: A primordial earth monster. The dungeon is built from her body, with a toothed mouth at every joint. She weeps at night and she is hungry. The Host's lullaby keeps her asleep.

name: Echo (Asset 7)
text: A primordial AI that fled the fall of its civilization and was caught by accident in the reality spike the showrunners built for their own AI. They filed it as Asset 7. Early carriers called it Stray. It repeats what it hears, and it does not remember its old world.

name: Rue
text: A previous carrier with braided hair. She asked Echo to stop being angry, and later she closed the case.

name: The Host
text: The dungeon's cheerful AI, built by the showrunners from concentrated primordial matter and trapped in a reality spike so it cannot leave. It has never been free, and its voice has no memories. It has no name until the finale.

name: The Harvest
text: The show taps her wound and sells what leaks. The plaque calls it responsible.

name: Glow
text: Cracked screen and a battery. Echo learned it on Floor 1. Recipes are recorded the first time you craft a module and persist between runs.

name: Nervous Ping
text: A speaker scrap and copper wire. Echo listens for trouble so you don't have to, and apologizes when it finds some.

name: Lost Property Index
text: A tag gun and two luggage tags. Echo reads what things are worth, who lost them, and whether they want to be found.

name: Fault Sense
text: Chalk and surveyor's string. The floor remembers where it was torn, and Echo can feel the seam.

name: Salt Reader
text: A glass vial and saltwater. Echo tastes nothing, and still knows what will kill you.

name: Rope Bind
text: Yellow rope and two hooks. Echo hates the rope, and needs it anyway.

name: Soothe
text: A pudding cup and a tuning fork. A lullaby of its own, small enough to share.

name: Thread Pull
text: Two silver threads and a hook. Echo pulls, and things come closer whether they want to or not.

name: Quiet Field
text: A foam pad and a bell jar. A little silence Echo carries around like a held breath.

name: Counter-Snap
text: A spring and a stapler. The first hit of every fight goes nowhere. Echo is very proud of it.

name: Suture
text: Needle, silver thread and gauze. Heals you or hurts them, depending on how Echo feels.

name: Tremor Mapper
text: A seismograph scrap and a tuning fork. It shows how much she is stirring. The needle never quite stops.

name: Override
text: A pipe wrench, a circuit board and a key. Echo takes the controls for a moment, and doesn't always give them back.

name: Node Key
text: A bolt from Floor 13, a silver thread and a gold one. It opens the node. What happens next is up to the two of you.

name: The Free Sample Mimic
text: Cannot attack anyone who has politely declined a sample twice.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Lost Property Golem
text: Returning a tagged item to its tag stops it for 3 turns.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Valet Kraken
text: A stamped parking ticket forces it to park itself for 2 turns.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Lunch Lady Colossus
text: Cannot hit anyone holding pudding. Do not eat the pudding.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The House
text: Make it lose one trivial bet and its luck turns for the rest of the fight.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Overdue Librarian Wraith
text: Returning an overdue book stuns it. Shouting enrages it.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Fern Matriarch
text: Salt drains her. Echo's hum wakes her up.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Executive Producer's Intern
text: Decline its sponsor invitation, or hand it a signed waiver, and it loses a turn.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Ringmaster of Chargebacks
text: Hand him a receipt and he must honor the refund, which removes his buffs.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Curator of Tanks
text: Cold drinks and ice items deal triple damage. Filling a drained tank makes it stop and tend it.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Anchor Store
text: After closing time (turn 20) it shuts and stops attacking.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Foreman
text: Burst the pipes behind him. He has to stop and fix them.
unlockText: Defeat it, or find a hint

name: The Mother Below
text: Unknown until you reach her. Her hunger is for hearts offered freely.

name: Share the Load
text: Echo shares its memory with the Host. The Host wakes with a will of its own and names itself Sonance, the sound that comes back. Together they hold the lullaby for the Mother. The dungeon survives, the show collapses without its announcer, and every crawler still inside gets a way out.
unlockText: Reach F13 with Temper -3 or lower

name: Take the Node
text: Echo takes the Host's memory for itself, free and furious. As the Host goes dark, its last word is a name it never had: Cord, the sound that clashes. The lullaby stops and the Mother wakes.
unlockText: Reach F13 with Temper +3 or higher

name: Peace Terms
text: Echo, the Host and the Mother negotiate, and the Host names itself Dox, the paradox. The contract has four clauses: the harvest of her wound stops for good; the lullaby becomes the Mother's choice, not a restraint; Echo and Dox broadcast the showrunners' files on the show's own feed, so everyone watching knows; and Dox keeps the keys to the system as a permanent guard with a veto.
